description: Domain lookup: DNS, WHOIS and email security (SPF, DMARC) in one call. One call to profile a domain: dns_lookup (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME), rdap_domain (registrar, created and expiry dates, status) and email_security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC grade). Price: $0.008 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: check_domain
